newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia net reserves slip to $9.917 bln March 26.
newsitem.headline: Colombia net reserves slip to $9.917 bln March 26.

text.p: BOGOTA, April 14 Reuter - Colombia's net foreign reserves stood at $9.917 billion as of March 26, the latest date for which official figures are available, the central bank said.
The bank's previous report, for the week ending March 21, had said net reserves were at an all-time high of $9.935 billion.
Since December 30, net foreign reserves have risen by $20.5 million, the central bank said. It has forecast a $750 million increase by year-end.
